# lcd.drawFilledCircle

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Draw a filled circle.

```lua
lcd.drawFilledCircle(x, y, r)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | number | yes | X coordinate of the center of the circle |
| `y` | number | yes | Y coordinate of the center of the circle |
| `r` | number | yes | circle radius |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua
-- status LED: green when telemetry is live, red otherwise
local ON, OFF = lcd.RGB(40, 200, 60), lcd.RGB(200, 40, 40)

local function drawLed(x, y, r, on)
  lcd.color(on and ON or OFF)
  lcd.drawFilledCircle(x, y, r)
end
```
